query:
SELECT items.kind AS "kind!", items.id AS "id!", items.what AS "what!", items.owner_id,
               items.owner_kind, items.owner, items.sha256, items.size_bytes, items.trashed_at AS "trashed_at!",
               u.username AS "trashed_by?",
               items.trashed_at + make_interval(days => $1) AS "purgeable_at!"
        FROM (
            SELECT 'cover' AS kind, c.id, 'cover' AS what,
                   COALESCE(c.track_id, c.album_id) AS owner_id,
                   CASE WHEN c.track_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'track' ELSE 'album' END AS owner_kind,
                   COALESCE(t.title, al.title) AS owner,
                   c.blob_sha256 AS sha256, NULL::bigint AS size_bytes, c.trashed_at, c.trashed_by
            FROM covers c
            LEFT JOIN tracks t ON t.id = c.track_id
            LEFT JOIN albums al ON al.id = c.album_id
            WHERE c.trashed_at IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'source', s.id, s.platform || COALESCE(' ' || s.external_id, ''),
                   COALESCE(s.track_id, s.album_id, s.artist_id, s.grouping_id),
                   CASE WHEN s.track_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'track'
                        WHEN s.album_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'album'
                        WHEN s.artist_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'artist' ELSE 'grouping' END,
                   COALESCE(t.title, al.title, ar.name, g.name),
                   NULL, NULL, s.trashed_at, s.trashed_by
            FROM sources s
            LEFT JOIN tracks t ON t.id = s.track_id
            LEFT JOIN albums al ON al.id = s.album_id
            LEFT JOIN artists ar ON ar.id = s.artist_id
            LEFT JOIN groupings g ON g.id = s.grouping_id
            WHERE s.trashed_at IS NOT NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'file', f.id, COALESCE(f.original_filename, f.uploaded_filename), h.track_id, 'track', t.title,
                   f.sha256, f.size_bytes, f.trashed_at, f.trashed_by
            FROM files f
            LEFT JOIN track_file_history h ON h.old_file_id = f.id
            LEFT JOIN tracks t ON t.id = h.track_id
            WHERE f.trashed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.purged_at IS NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'extra', e.id, e.name, e.merged_into, 'extra', m.name, NULL, NULL, e.trashed_at, e.trashed_by
            FROM extras e
            LEFT JOIN extras m ON m.id = e.merged_into
            WHERE e.trashed_at IS NOT NULL AND e.purged_at IS NULL
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 'problem', p.id, p.uploaded_filename, NULL, NULL, NULL,
                   p.sha256, p.size_bytes, p.resolved_at, p.resolved_by
            FROM ingest_problems p
            WHERE p.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND p.track_id IS NULL AND p.audio_purged_at IS NULL
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM files f WHERE f.sha256 = p.sha256 AND f.purged_at IS NULL)
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM extra_files e WHERE e.sha256 = p.sha256)
              -- The same file listed again later: that entry stands for it.
              AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ingest_problems o
                              WHERE o.sha256 = p.sha256 AND o.id <> p.id AND o.audio_purged_at IS NULL
                                AND (o.resolved_at IS NULL OR o.resolved_at > p.resolved_at))
        ) items
        LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = items.trashed_by
        ORDER BY items.trashed_at, items.id
